title.en: Preparing people for university, work and a healthy life.
title.uz: Odamlarni universitet, ish va sog'lom hayotga tayyorlaymiz.

text.en: We teach English and Ona tili, prepare students for the certificates they need, and build free tools for training and injury recovery.
text.uz: Ingliz tili va ona tilini o'qitamiz, talabalarni kerakli sertifikatlarga tayyorlaymiz hamda mashg'ulot va jarohatdan tiklanish uchun bepul vositalar yaratamiz.

text.en: Our sport and health tools are open to everyone. The Education Portal for our students and teachers is being prepared.
text.uz: Sport va sog'liq vositalarimiz hamma uchun ochiq. O'quvchi va o'qituvchilarimiz uchun Ta'lim portali tayyorlanmoqda.

text.en: Free apps and guides for football training, everyday fitness and recovering from injury.
text.uz: Futbol mashg'ulotlari, kundalik fitnes va jarohatdan tiklanish uchun bepul ilovalar va qo'llanmalar.

points.en: Joint Rehab — recovery plans for 28 injuries
points.uz: Joint Rehab — 28 ta jarohat uchun tiklanish rejalari

points.en: Injury guides in English, Uzbek and Russian
points.uz: Ingliz, o'zbek va rus tillarida jarohat qo'llanmalari

points.uz: IKJON Fitness — erkak va ayollar uchun kundalik rejalar

points.uz: Football Training — pozitsiya va darajaga mos dasturlar

text.en: Courses, learning apps and student progress in one place, for IKJON students and teachers.
text.uz: IKJON o'quvchi va o'qituvchilari uchun kurslar, o'quv ilovalari va o'quvchi natijalari bir joyda.

points.uz: Ingliz tili kurslari va imtihonlarga tayyorgarlik

points.en: Learning apps for grammar, vocabulary and IELTS
points.uz: Grammatika, lug'at va IELTS uchun o'quv ilovalari

text.en: IKJON is an education and consulting centre. Our main focus is getting students ready for university or work.
text.uz: IKJON — ta'lim va konsalting markazi. Asosiy maqsadimiz — o'quvchilarni universitet yoki ishga tayyorlash.

text.en: General English from beginner to advanced level, Kids English, and Ona tili lessons.
text.uz: Boshlang'ichdan yuqori darajagacha umumiy ingliz tili, bolalar uchun ingliz tili va ona tili darslari.

text.en: IELTS and CEFR preparation, plus advice on choosing a university or a career path.
text.uz: IELTS va CEFR tayyorgarligi hamda universitet yoki kasb tanlash bo'yicha maslahat.

text.en: Free apps and guides for football training, daily fitness and injury recovery, based on published research.
text.uz: E'lon qilingan tadqiqotlarga asoslangan futbol mashg'ulotlari, kundalik fitnes va jarohatdan tiklanish uchun bepul ilovalar va qo'llanmalar.

text.en: Our lessons and health plans follow recognised standards and published research.
text.uz: Darslarimiz va sog'liq rejalarimiz tan olingan standartlar va e'lon qilingan tadqiqotlarga asoslanadi.

text.en: We are clear about what our tools can do. They do not replace a teacher, doctor or physiotherapist.
text.uz: Vositalarimiz nimaga qodir ekanini ochiq aytamiz. Ular o'qituvchi, shifokor yoki fizioterapevt o'rnini bosmaydi.

text.en: Our free apps need no account and do not track you. Your data stays on your device.
text.uz: Bepul ilovalarimiz hisob talab qilmaydi va sizni kuzatmaydi. Ma'lumotlaringiz qurilmangizda qoladi.

text.en: Our sport and health tools are free and available in Uzbek, Russian and English.
text.uz: Sport va sog'liq vositalarimiz bepul va o'zbek, rus hamda ingliz tillarida mavjud.

text.en: Every student leaves with the knowledge and certificates they need for their next step.
text.uz: Har bir o'quvchi keyingi qadami uchun kerakli bilim va sertifikatlar bilan chiqadi.

text.en: Open the Education Portal so courses, homework and progress are in one place.
text.uz: Kurslar, uy vazifalari va natijalar bir joyda bo'lishi uchun Ta'lim portalini ochish.

text.en: The same teaching standard across all our teachers and future branches.
text.uz: Barcha o'qituvchilarimiz va kelajakdagi filiallarimizda bir xil ta'lim sifati.

text.en: Keep our fitness and recovery apps accurate, free and up to date.
text.uz: Fitnes va tiklanish ilovalarimizni aniq, bepul va dolzarb holda saqlash.

text.en: For courses, partnerships or questions about our apps, email ikjongearbox@gmail.com.
text.uz: Kurslar, hamkorlik yoki ilovalarimiz bo'yicha savollar uchun ikjongearbox@gmail.com manziliga yozing.

title.en: Train, stay healthy and recover from injury
title.uz: Mashq qiling, sog'lom bo'ling va jarohatdan tiklaning

text.en: Free apps and guides from IKJON. They open in any browser, can be installed on your phone and keep working offline. No account needed.
text.uz: IKJON'ning bepul ilovalari va qo'llanmalari. Ular istalgan brauzerda ochiladi, telefonga o'rnatiladi va internetsiz ham ishlaydi. Hisob shart emas.

text.en: Step-by-step recovery plans after a sports injury, with exercises matched to how severe it is.
text.uz: Sport jarohatidan keyin og'irligiga mos mashqlar bilan bosqichma-bosqich tiklanish rejalari.

points.en: 28 injuries, including 5 types of groin pain
points.uz: 28 ta jarohat, shu jumladan chov og'rig'ining 5 turi

text.en: Clear explanations of common sports injuries: what is injured, how it heals and which exercises help.
text.uz: Keng tarqalgan sport jarohatlari haqida aniq tushuntirishlar: nima shikastlangan, qanday bitadi va qaysi mashqlar yordam beradi.

points.en: Free to read, no app needed

text.en: Daily health and fitness plans for men and women, from a 20-minute routine to 3-month programmes.
text.uz: Erkak va ayollar uchun kundalik salomatlik va fitnes rejalari: 20 daqiqalik mashg'ulotdan 3 oylik dasturlargacha.

points.uz: Erkaklar va ayollar uchun 3 oylik rejalar

points.en: Posture, hair and scalp care routines
points.uz: Qomat, soch va bosh terisi parvarishi

text.en: Skill training for footballers of every position and level.
text.uz: Har qanday pozitsiya va darajadagi futbolchilar uchun mahorat mashg'ulotlari.

note.en: Our health apps give general guidance. If you are injured, get a diagnosis from a doctor or physiotherapist first.
note.uz: Sog'liq ilovalarimiz umumiy yo'riqnoma beradi. Jarohat olgan bo'lsangiz, avval shifokor yoki fizioterapevtdan tashxis oling.
